title: Deliver Steel to Penfingbridge Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Steel** delivered to **Penfingbridge Factory** (industry id 11, near tile 27,17).

A likely supplier is **Fort Suningville Steel Mill** (industry id 6, near tile 42,4); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **1,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
